subject: Kickoff synthesis: scope, success metrics, owners & access matrix
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@veridian.ai>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@veridian.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff synthesis: scope, success metrics, owners & access matrix

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick synthesis of what we heard and the concrete next steps to get a pilot running. Please flag anything I misunderstood.

Summary of pain + goals
- Pain: model latency and cost spikes when Veridian scales inference-heavy pipelines (batch + interactive).
- Business goal: reduce per-call cost while maintaining <= 250ms 95th pctl latency for the top 3 endpoints.
- Data constraints: patient PII in some records; Veridian requires VPC/private deployment for PHI workflows.

Proposed pilot scope (30 days)
- Model/feature: inference of the Assistant endpoint (text-generation), capped to 8k tokens per request.
- Throughput target: 100 reqs/min sustained (spiky bursts to 600/min).
- Success metrics: 95th pctl latency <= 250ms, unit cost < $0.0009/token on average, and functional match rate >= 92% on the prompt eval set.
- Eval plan: 500-sample prompt set from Veridian (will share examples); Redwood to run cost/latency baseline + optimized run (batching + KV cache) and present side-by-side.

Owners & roles
- Veridian: Elena (product lead) = success sponsor; Tom (infra) = technical owner; will introduce their tech lead for onboarding.
- Redwood: Jonas (AE) = engagement owner; Grace O'Connor (CS) = pilot delivery lead; Ben Carter (SE) = runtime/infra contact and prompt-eval engineer.

Access and data needs (items Veridian to provide before kickoff)
1) Service account + limited IP allowlist for test VPC ingress (screenshot or CIDR).
2) Example prompt set (CSV) + expected output samples for 500 eval cases.
3) Minimal dataset for integration testing (anonymized / synthetic if PHI).
4) Procurement contact + PO window if you want Redwood Dedicated reserved capacity.

Attachments: Redwood-MA-Questionnaire.pdf (security/compliance checklist) attached; I also created a Launch-Access-Template.csv (outline of fields we need) and linked it in the Drive folder below.

Immediate next steps
- Elena: share prompt set & introduce tech lead (by Wed 5/26).
- Veridian infra: confirm whether we proceed with Private (VPC) or Dedicated (monthly commit) for the pilot.
- Redwood: Grace/Ben will propose a round-1 test plan and a concrete kickoff date (within 5 business days of access availability).

Suggested kickoff window: Tue 5/25 – Fri 5/28. If that works, we’ll block 90 minutes for kickoff + hands-on access verification.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0122
https://redwood.ai

From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@veridian.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@veridian.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 17:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff synthesis: scope, success metrics, owners & access matrix

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful and aligns with our notes. A few clarifications and asks from our side: 

1) Timeline: our PM calendar is tight next week; earliest we can guarantee the prompt set + tech lead intro is Mon 5/31. Ok if kickoff slips to the week of 6/1?
2) Security: we’ll need your SOC2 Type II report and a short writeup on how you manage KV cache for inference (we operate under strict audit windows). Can you send those?
3) Scope tweak: one of our high-volume endpoints returns structured JSON; can we include a small structured-output test (50 cases) as part of the 500 samples? That will help us measure functional match.

I’ll loop in procurement separately if we move toward a Dedicated commit for the pilot.

Elena
Elena Rios
Head of Product, Veridian AI
elena.rios@veridian.ai

Elena — thanks for the quick clarifications. Summary of follow-ups from Redwood (copying Grace and Ben to own delivery pieces):

- Timeline update: we’re flexible — kickoff week of 6/1 is fine. Grace, can you propose two 90-minute slots during 6/1–6/4?
- SOC2 and KV cache note: attaching the SOC2 summary (see Redwood-MA-Questionnaire.pdf) and a short runbook on KV cache behavior (excerpt below). Ben will follow up with a technical note on cache eviction and how we preserve determinism across quantized kernels.

Quoted for context:
> Elena: "Timeline: our PM calendar is tight next week; earliest we can guarantee the prompt set + tech lead intro is Mon 5/31."

Concerning the structured JSON test: absolutely — please include the 50 structured-output cases as part of the 500. We’ll add a dedicated eval slice for structured output accuracy and latency.

Access matrix (what Redwood needs before kickoff)
- IAM/service account + minimal VPC info (CIDR or peered project) — infra to verify connectivity.
- Test keys/credentials in a short-lived sandbox project (we do not require production keys).
- Example event/record formats (CSV/JSON) for integration sanity checks.

Logistics & docs
- Attached: Veridian-Launch-Access-Template.csv (fill this and drop it in the Drive folder).
- HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/VER-2027-113
- Proposed pilot kickoff agenda (high level): 1) access verification, 2) baseline run + sample evals, 3) plan for optimizations, 4) success gates & telemetry.

Action owners: Jonas (engagement), Grace (delivery), Ben (SE/infra).

Next: Grace — can you propose slots; Ben — can you prepare the KV cache technical note and an access checklist template?

—
Jonas

Hi Elena / Tom — Grace from Redwood CS here. Welcome — excited to run this pilot. Quick commitments from our side and a proposed kickoff slot.

Commitments
- I’ll own pilot delivery cadence, weekly status summaries, and the eval dashboard we’ll use to track latency/cost/functional match.
- Ben will own the infra run and KV cache tuning; he’ll post the technical note by EOD 5/25.

Proposed kickoff slots (90m):
- Tue Jun 1, 2027 — 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Jun 2, 2027 — 14:00–15:30 PT

Please confirm which slot works and share the tech lead contact.

Action items for Veridian before kickoff
- Fill and return Veridian-Launch-Access-Template.csv (attached)
- Share the 500-sample prompt set (including 50 structured tests) in the Drive folder linked earlier
- Confirm preferred deployment mode (Private VPC vs Dedicated) so we can pre-config capacity/credentials

DocuSign / procurement: if you prefer a Dedicated reserved capacity pilot we can share a short MSA addendum + DocuSign link; Jonas — I’ll coordinate with you on the paperwork cadence.

Thanks — will stand by to lock a slot once you confirm.

Best,
